No. Over the measurement week **Jan 1–7, 2000**, Bus_29 had **0 undervoltage violations and 0 near misses** against the 0.95 p.u. lower limit. Its lowest recorded voltage was **0.989 p.u.** There were no undervoltage episodes, so there’s no cause pattern to compare.
